title: VIA, Cognitively-Grounded Vision-Language-Action Model
alt: A camera feeding a bell-shaped belief over a latent state, which then drives a robot arm
stack: Python · PyTorch · SigLIP · RSSM world model · active inference · LIBERO
description: A vision-language-action model that infers a latent world state instead of mapping observations straight to actions.
bullets: Replacing direct observation-to-action mapping with probabilistic inference over a latent world state, across five PyTorch modules for perception, belief filtering, RSA goal inference, world modeling, and CEM planning.
Trained on the LIBERO spatial suite (432 demonstrations) on UCSD DSMLP A5000 GPUs, root-causing a belief-state variance collapse to the absence of occlusions in the demonstration data.
shortTitle: VIA, a Cognitively Grounded VLA Model
summary: A vision-language-action model that infers a latent world state and plans over it, instead of mapping pixels straight to actions.
artAlt: A low-poly robot arm reaching over a table to pick up a gold block, watched by a camera on a post

title: Room Mesh to MuJoCo Simulation Environment
alt: A wireframe mesh of a scanned room becoming a solid simulation scene with a robot arm and a box
description: Building a pipeline that turns a scanned 3D room mesh into a simulation-ready MuJoCo environment, so real captured spaces can be used directly as robot-learning scenes.
summary: A pipeline that turns a scanned 3D room into a simulation-ready MuJoCo scene, so real spaces become robot-learning environments.
artAlt: A small room whose left half is solid stone and whose right half dissolves into a triangle mesh

title: Macro Optimizer, Constrained Meal Optimization
alt: A shaded region of meal plans that fit budget and macro limits, with the cheapest plan marked at one corner
stack: Python · PuLP/CBC integer linear programming · Flask · pytest
description: An integer-linear-programming engine that plans the cheapest UCSD campus meals that hit daily macro targets.
bullets: Built an integer-linear-programming engine that finds the cheapest combination of UCSD campus food meeting daily macro targets within a dining-dollar budget, with a soft-constraint fallback when no exact solution fits.

Integrated live nutrition data from UCSD Dining, Open Food Facts, and USDA FoodData Central behind a Flask app and weekly menu planner with anti-repetition and time-budget constraints, backed by a pytest suite.
summary: An integer-programming engine that finds the cheapest UC San Diego campus meals hitting daily macro targets on a dining-dollar budget.
artAlt: Three meal bowls on a table beside three bars of different heights and a small stack of gold coins

title: PiCar Lane Following and Obstacle Avoidance
alt: A small car seen from above between two lane lines, with a detected obstacle ahead and a model suggesting it pass on the left
description: Real-time lane following and obstacle avoidance on a PiCar, with a vision-language model helping make driving decisions.
bullets: Built real-time lane-following and obstacle-avoidance control on a PiCar platform using computer vision for lane detection.
Prototyped a vision-language-model decision manager using scene understanding to inform real-time driving decisions (course project, DSC 190).
summary: Real-time lane following and obstacle avoidance on a PiCar, with a vision-language model prototyped as its decision manager.
artAlt: A small car following a lane, with a dashed path curving around rocks in the road ahead

title: Selene Nanorobotics, Sensing & Navigation for Root-Canal Microrobots
alt: A tooth with a microrobot inside one root canal, linked by dashed lines to four sensors around it
description: Selene is building magnetically steered microrobots that clear bacterial biofilm from inside root canals. I lead sensor simulation and navigation, building the simulator that works out how to tell where a robot is inside the canal, and turning it into a tool that searches for better robot designs and sensor layouts. Specifics are under NDA.
summary: Simulating how to sense where a magnetically steered microrobot is inside a root canal, and searching for better robot and sensor designs.

title: Triton AI, Perception for an Autonomous Vehicle
alt: A car seen from above, with front and rear camera views and rings of LiDAR points around it
description: On UC San Diego's student autonomy team, I brought up our vehicle's first full sensing suite: front and rear cameras plus a 360° LiDAR, calibrated into one synchronized view of the world.
summary: Brought up the first full sensing suite on UC San Diego's student race car: front and rear cameras and a 360° LiDAR in one calibrated view.
artAlt: A car on a small test track, ringed by LiDAR sweeps, with camera views cast to the front and rear

title: Why We Procrastinate, Reinforcement Learning Research
alt: Bar chart where effort stays low over time and spikes just before a deadline, under a rising curve of discounted value
description: In Prof. Lucy Lai's group in UC San Diego Cognitive Science, I am rewriting the Bellman equation so agents procrastinate the way people do, then fitting them to human data to test whether discounting the future is enough to explain it.
summary: Rewriting the Bellman equation so reinforcement-learning agents put things off the way people do, then fitting them to human data.
artAlt: A clock tower over a row of low steps that leap up just before a deadline flag

title: DataWorks, AI Interpretability Lab
alt: Persona points spread along one axis, from other personas to the Assistant, with a dashed line marking the activation cap
description: I lead an AI interpretability lab inside UC San Diego's student data science organization, working through Anthropic's <cite>The Assistant Axis</cite>, which finds a single activation direction tracking how much a model acts as its Assistant persona.
summary: Leading a student lab through Anthropic's Assistant Axis: one activation direction that tracks persona, and what capping drift along it does.
artAlt: A row of pillars along a straight axis, rising towards a glowing gold pillar behind a gate

title: DataWorks, Audio-Perception Lab
alt: A sound wave turned into a log-mel spectrogram, then into tokens feeding a transformer
description: I lead an audio-perception lab building a shared pipeline that turns raw sound into tokens a multimodal transformer can read, then testing whether one general model can match classifiers built for a single task.
summary: Leading a student lab that turns raw sound into tokens a multimodal transformer can read, and tests one model against task-specific classifiers.
artAlt: A round tower sending out rings of sound over a field of spectrogram bars beside a stacked block

title: The Social Adjacency of LLMs, Working Paper
alt: A person beside their friends, trading chat messages with a language model
description: With a colleague at UC Berkeley, I am writing a paper on why we treat LLMs as socially adjacent beings, building on David Chalmers' <cite>What We Talk to When We Talk to Language Models</cite> and Daniel Dennett's <cite>True Believers</cite>.
summary: A paper with a UC Berkeley colleague on why we treat language models as socially adjacent beings, building on Chalmers and Dennett.
artAlt: A circle of small figures trading speech bubbles with a softly glowing standing stone

alt: An eight-week timeline marking interpretability, RLHF, AI policy, and catastrophic risk, beside a stack of papers
description: An 8-week introduction to AI alignment adapted from MIT AI Alignment and BlueDot Impact materials, covering interpretability, RLHF, AI policy, and catastrophic risk.
meta: AI Alignment at UC San Diego
summary: An 8-week introduction to AI alignment covering interpretability, RLHF, AI policy, and catastrophic risk.

title: BinTek, CV-Assisted Data Pipeline
alt: A waste bin in a detection box labelled plastic, passing through FastAPI into PostgreSQL and out as a bar chart
description: A FastAPI and PostgreSQL pipeline that classifies waste with a computer-vision API.
bullets: Built a FastAPI backend with a PostgreSQL database for data ingestion, cleaning, storage, and statistical analysis.
Integrated the Eyepop.ai computer-vision API for automated data collection and waste classification.
summary: A FastAPI and PostgreSQL pipeline that gathers waste-sorting data through the Eyepop.ai vision API, then cleans and analyses it.
artAlt: Three colored waste bins under a camera on a pole, one outlined in a detection box, beside a stack of database disks

title: Menu Generator, Full-Stack Web App
alt: A weekly menu grid beside a stack of React, Spring Boot, and MariaDB
stack: React/Node.js · Spring Boot REST API · MariaDB
description: A full-stack menu-planning web app, from database schema to production deployment.
bullets: Architected and deployed a full-stack menu-planning web app end to end, with a React/Node.js frontend, a Spring Boot REST API, and a self-hosted MariaDB database on a NAS.
Designed the data model, REST endpoints, and a responsive UI, owning the system from schema through production deployment.
summary: A full-stack menu planner, from data model to production, with a React front end, Spring Boot API, and self-hosted MariaDB.
artAlt: A long dinner table set with plates, a menu board beside it and a small server box with glowing lights

title: RoboNurse
date: May 2024, DA Hacks 3.5 hackathon award winner
alt: A small robot with a medical cross on its chest, hearing symptoms and answering with an analysis
description: A nursing-assistant robot that listens to symptoms and analyses them.
bullets: Programmed Arduino in C++ for movement and Raspberry Pi in Python for speech processing in a nursing-assistant robot.
Integrated the ChatGPT API for symptom analysis.
summary: A nursing-assistant robot that drives on an Arduino, listens on a Raspberry Pi, and uses ChatGPT to analyse symptoms.
artAlt: A friendly wheeled robot with a red cross on its chest, beside a bed, its antenna glowing
